content: linux qemu tap/bridge (verified qemu docs via Guix cookbook + OpenWrt scripts): one-time privileged setup = setuid qemu-bridge-helper (shipped in qemu-system-common/qemu-kvm-common; on NixOS via security.wrappers) + /etc/qemu/bridge.conf 'allow br0' (default deny-all) + host bridge br0 (ip link add type bridge; attach uplink or stand-alone with host IP + optional dnsmasq); then unprivileged: -netdev bridge,id=n0,br=br0,helper=<path> -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0,mac=52:54:00:... (unique MAC per guest mandatory). Alternative lima-privileged-net pattern: privileged helper does ip tuntap add user=$UID and hands the tap fd to unprivileged qemu. Zero-privilege fallback: -netdev user,hostfwd=tcp::17010-:17010 (slirp) suffices for host->guest drawterm since p9sk1/9P ride TCP.
